changelog:
- Fixed Scrolling & Auto-Refresh: Disabled aggressive swipe-to-refresh gesture hijacking so all web pages, articles, and media feeds scroll buttery smooth with native 120Hz physics without unexpected reloads.
- Custom Wallpaper Upload: Fixed wallpaper upload by integrating background downsampling to 1080p JPEG with direct app storage persistence, eliminating memory limits and localStorage quota errors.
- Real-Time Multi-Tab Theme Sync: Selecting or uploading any theme now immediately syncs across all open tabs simultaneously and persists automatically for all newly opened tabs.
- High-Contrast Header Buttons: Redesigned Ghost Mode and Live Pulse buttons with frosted obsidian glass pills ensuring 100% legibility and high contrast on any wallpaper or bright background.
- Firefox-Style Search Engine Quick Switcher: Added a fast horizontal search engine switcher in the URL suggestions card with 1-tap switching between Ecosia, Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, and Startpage.
- Live Pulse Hub Overhaul: Redesigned the Weather Card into clean non-overlapping rows, fixed City Picker modal z-index so location customization works seamlessly, enhanced Markets & Currencies tickers, unboxed news cards into an editorial layout, and added multi-category news filtering (All, Tech & AI, Markets, World, Science & Space, Sports, Entertainment).
